third-party: knitr — kable()'s HTML output leaves the row-name corner cell as an empty <th> by design, not oversight: yihui/knitr#1747 (https://github.com/yihui/knitr/issues/1747), merged as PR #2500 on 2026-09-19, added scope="col"/scope="row" to kable's other header cells but explicitly kept this one blank -- "the empty corner cell above the row names is not a header for either dimension and gets no scope."
